changeSet.author: flowstaff
changeSet.comment: Initialize migration tracking; domain tables belong to later stages.

changeSet.author: flowstaff
changeSet.comment: Store deterministic operational and historical attrition feature snapshots.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE attrition_feature_snapshots ( id BIGINT UNSIGNED AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, employee_snapshot_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL, employee_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, snapshot_date DATE NOT NULL, tenure_months BIGINT NOT NULL, employment_rate DECIMAL(4,2) NOT NULL, department_code VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, position_code VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, active_projects_count INT NOT NULL, active_tasks_count INT NOT NULL, overdue_tasks_30d INT NOT NULL, completed_tasks_90d INT NOT NULL, avg_task_delay_days_90d DECIMAL(9,2) NOT NULL, avg_workload_30d DECIMAL(7,2) NOT NULL, avg_workload_90d DECIMAL(7,2) NOT NULL, overload_days_30d INT NOT NULL, overload_days_90d INT NOT NULL, absence_days_90d INT NOT NULL, task_reassignments_90d INT NOT NULL, project_changes_180d INT NOT NULL, target_label TINYINT NULL, source VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, schema_version VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, generated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), UNIQUE KEY ux_feature_snapshot_id (employee_snapshot_id), UNIQUE KEY ux_feature_employee_date_source (employee_id,snapshot_date,source), KEY ix_feature_snapshot_date (snapshot_date), CONSTRAINT ck_feature_target CHECK (target_label IS NULL OR target_label IN (0,1)), CONSTRAINT ck_feature_nonnegative CHECK ( tenure_months>=0 AND active_projects_count>=0 AND active_tasks_count>=0 AND overdue_tasks_30d>=0 AND completed_tasks_90d>=0 AND overload_days_30d>=0 AND overload_days_90d>=0 AND absence_days_90d>=0 AND task_reassignments_90d>=0 AND project_changes_180d>=0 ) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

changeSet.author: flowstaff
changeSet.comment: Store historical dataset import batches and allow missing numeric features for later imputation.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE ml_import_batches ( batch_id CHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY, filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, row_count INT NOT NULL, valid_count INT NOT NULL, invalid_count INT NOT NULL, imported_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, schema_version VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, KEY ix_ml_import_batches_imported_at (imported_at) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci; ALTER TABLE attrition_feature_snapshots MODIFY tenure_months BIGINT NULL, MODIFY employment_rate DECIMAL(4,2) NULL, MODIFY active_projects_count INT NULL, MODIFY active_tasks_count INT NULL, MODIFY overdue_tasks_30d INT NULL, MODIFY completed_tasks_90d INT NULL, MODIFY avg_task_delay_days_90d DECIMAL(9,2) NULL, MODIFY avg_workload_30d DECIMAL(7,2) NULL, MODIFY avg_workload_90d DECIMAL(7,2) NULL, MODIFY overload_days_30d INT NULL, MODIFY overload_days_90d INT NULL, MODIFY absence_days_90d INT NULL, MODIFY task_reassignments_90d INT NULL, MODIFY project_changes_180d INT NULL;

changeSet.author: flowstaff
changeSet.comment: Register versioned attrition models and reproducible training runs.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE ml_model_versions ( id BIGINT UNSIGNED AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, version VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL UNIQUE, algorithm VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, trained_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, artifact_path VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, feature_schema_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL, training_dataset_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL, feature_schema JSON NOT NULL, metrics JSON NOT NULL, training_rows INT NOT NULL, test_rows INT NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), KEY ix_ml_model_versions_active (active,trained_at) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci; CREATE TABLE ml_training_runs ( run_id CHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY, model_version_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL, started_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, finished_at DATETIME(6) NULL, status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, parameters JSON NOT NULL, metrics JSON NULL, error_message VARCHAR(1000) NULL, idempotency_key CHAR(36) NOT NULL UNIQUE, CONSTRAINT fk_training_run_model FOREIGN KEY (model_version_id) REFERENCES ml_model_versions(id), KEY ix_ml_training_runs_started (started_at) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
